en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazal Bin Shazaan, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the brothers from the mother, with the grandfather, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the brothers from the mother, their Obligation (legislated share) is the one-third, with the grandfather’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan from ibn Muskan from al-Halabiy who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of brothers from one’s mother with a grandfather.
He (the Imam) said, ‘The ordained share of brothers from one’s mother is one-third if a grandfather is with them.’”
